versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support recording timing events of category 2 interrupt states Description: AUTOSAR shall support the recording and tracing of category 2 interrupt state changes. Rationale: Provide a standardized way to trace timing events on category 2 interrupt state changes to ensure tool compatibility and compatibility to TIMEX. Dependencies: – Use Case: Add a trace instrumentation to category 2 interrupt state changes. Supporting Material: -
